units.title: Water is Everywhere
units.description: Understanding that water is essential for all living things.
steps: Observe how plants need water to grow.
List activities like drinking, bathing, and cleaning that require water.
Recognize that humans, animals, and plants cannot survive without water.

units.title: Forms of Water
units.description: Basic introduction to ice, water, and steam.
steps: See steam rising from a hot cup (gas).
